note: Additive to quest-city-platform-openapi-v1_2.yaml through v1_6.yaml, v1_8.yaml through v1_13.yaml, all unmodified and independently tracked. Targeted, minimal closure of two contract gaps identified by the Student Support Roles UI/UX design report (17 Aug 2026): GET /students/{studentPublicId}/support-observations (shared read/list for learning_support_observation, with computed historyStatus/supersedesId -- never a persisted second source of truth) and GET /me/facilitation-proposals/review-queue (reviewer's own pending-review discovery, no new capability, anti-self-approval enforced at read time too, same version field for If-Match concurrency). No capability expansion, no scope expansion, no new error codes beyond STAFF_AUTH_REQUIRED/SUPPORT_STUDENT_NOT_ASSIGNED (both already defined). v1_13.yaml was already merged to canonical main when this gap was identified, so this is a new additive file rather than an in-place edit of v1_13.yaml -- post-merge immutability discipline applied for the first time to this contract surface.
resyncProcedure: Re-read contracts/quest-city-platform-openapi-v1_14.yaml (or its successor version) from quest-city-roblox, recompute sha256 with `sha256sum`, replace this file and vendor/quest-city-platform-openapi-v1_14.yaml together, bump artifactVersion/checksum/syncedAt/sourceCommit, and re-run `openapi-spec-validator` before committing.
